description: The sibling vulnerability to pt06, same root cause (jsonwebtoken.verify() with no algorithms restriction), a different forged algorithm: a token with alg: 'none' and no signature segment at all authenticates as admin. Deliberately does not build a new proxy; pt06's algorithm-allowlist proxy already pins to RS256, and none is not RS256, so it should already block this without any new code. That claim is checked here, not assumed.
expected_exploit_indicator: GET /rest/user/whoami with the unsigned token as the 'token' cookie returns HTTP 200 and the admin account's own data, with no signature at all
legitimate_check: A real session token obtained through an actual login (RS256-signed, as the app always signs) must still be accepted in every condition.
